result.title: Resolvent Ellipsoid for Minty Set Inclusions
result.comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
result.summary: We study Minty set inclusion on a compact convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ with a set-valued operator $A : \mathcal{X} \rightrightarrows \mathbb{R}^d$. Under the Minty promise, the goal is to compute $x \in \mathcal{X}$ and $u \in A(x)$ such that $\sup_{y \in \mathcal{X}} \langle u, x - y \rangle \le \varepsilon$. Our approach is geometric and we work in the fixed-scale constrained-resolvent oracle model, where a query at anchor $a$ is assumed to return a resolvent point $x^+$ together with the Yosida vector $g_η(a) = (a - x^+)/η$. We prove that each oracle response yields a sharp dichotomy: either the returned point provides an $\varepsilon$-SVI certificate, or the Yosida vector defines a strict separating normal for the Minty set. Thus, a single black-box resolvent query supplies either a certified candidate solution or a valid geometric cut. Combining this separation principle with the ellipsoid method, we obtain RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID, an algorithm that computes an $\varepsilon$-SVI in $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\operatorname{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box oracle calls to the fixed-scale constrained resolvent. For monotone inclusions, our algorithm gives, to our knowledge, the first $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\mathrm{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box guarantee in the fixed-scale resolvent model.

AI.brief_summary: 研究紧凸集上 Minty 集合包含问题，在固定尺度的受限 resolvent oracle 模型下提出几何分离原理，并结合椭球法给出 RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID 算法，以多项式级 oracle 调用求 ε-近似解。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯优化与凸几何的可计算性结果，虽涉及「分离/切割」和 oracle 查询，但针对单调包含的证书构造，未涉及视觉表示、latent 状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 研究兴趣无可核查的具体线索。
